<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="slayer-point-farming" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Slayer Point Farming</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Slayer Points are a currency obtained by completing Slayer Assignments which have several uses, such as skipping Slayer Assignments, purchasing consumables such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1097515642749468752.png?v=1" alt="ushabti" title="ushabti" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and purchasing permanent unlocks at Slayer Masters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This mini-guide will outline a method of effectively farming these points without having to complete lengthy, high levelled Slayer Assignments.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="requirements"><ins><nowiki>Requirements</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Completion of The Blood Pact quest for access to the Lumbridge Catacombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optional: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345365471232.png?v=1" alt="slayerintrospection" title="slayerintrospection" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Slayer Introspection to guarantee the shortest assignments possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optional: lunar spellbook Spellbook swap (Lunar) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1" alt="SBSLunars" title="SBSLunars" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + NPC Contact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284195280695326.png?v=1" alt="npccontact" title="npccontact" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Blocklist</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Copy the blocklist below to ensure that all Slayer Assignments given by Jacquelyn will be to slay monsters present in the Lumbridge Catacombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Jacquelyn Blocklist</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Cave Bugs
⬥ Cows
⬥ Cave Slimes
⬥ Frogs
⬥ Birds
⬥ Ghosts
⬥ Rats
⬥ Spiders
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=d6whBtns6jFiz3bUW4Ct <nowiki>Low-level Magic camp</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/cc4ef3b22d4b4f86b92024974b1b4afbd28a7dc7fa0940a8a6145e57f51661af.webp" alt="Slayer Point farming low lvl gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=cLt3Q6IWW5L8jSziWDUB <nowiki>High-level Hybrid</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FcLt3Q6IWW5L8jSziWDUB.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-method"><ins><nowiki>The Method</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This method consists of doing 9 Slayer Assignments with Jacquelyn </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345369665577.png?v=1" alt="jacquelyn" title="jacquelyn" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, then doing the 10th with Laniakea </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345411600426.png?v=1" alt="laniakea" title="laniakea" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or your current highest level Slayer Master (not including Mandrith </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1" alt="mandrith" title="mandrith" kind="icon" /><nowiki>).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This takes advantage of the Slayer Point bonus awarded to the player after every 10th and 50th assignment completion while also letting us speed past assignments 1-9 with Jacquelyn's short and easy tasks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Raptor may also be used as they reward a good amount of Slayer Points while also having generally quicker assignments.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Before starting, ensure you are not currently on a Slayer streak that ends with a 9 by clicking on the Slayer icon located on the Slayer counter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be enabled in Settings &gt; Gameplay &gt; Interfaces &gt; Information Windows &gt; Slayer counter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>1) Enter the bottom floor of the Lumbridge Catacombs and stand in the Skeleton room.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>2) Use Spellbook swap (Lunar) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1" alt="SBSLunars" title="SBSLunars" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and then NPC Contact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284195280695326.png?v=1" alt="npccontact" title="npccontact" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to receive a Slayer Assignment from Jacquelyn </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284345369665577.png?v=1" alt="jacquelyn" title="jacquelyn" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (located at the bottom right of the interface).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>3) Slay the required monsters within the catacombs, all possible assignments can be completed in the southern half of the dungeon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a) With the high-level preset alternate between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1" alt="gchaincaroming" title="gchaincaroming" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b) If Magic camping prioritise AoE Magic spells such as Corruption Blast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159194259467.png?v=1" alt="corruptblast" title="corruptblast" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Greater Chain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Magma Tempest </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626509025290.png?v=1" alt="magmatempest" title="magmatempest" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎c) The Goblin used for this method, Skoblin, also count toward Skeleton assignments.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>4) Repeat steps 2 &amp; 3 until your streak ends in 9, which can be confirmed by either having the slayer counter expanded or double checking the message in chat that's received by the player after completing an assignment.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>5) Spellbook swap (Lunar) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1" alt="SBSLunars" title="SBSLunars" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + NPC Contact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284195280695326.png?v=1" alt="npccontact" title="npccontact" kind="icon" /><nowiki> again, this time receiving an assignment from your highest levelled Slayer Master (or the Raptor for faster tasks). Upon completion you'll be rewarded the bulk of the Slayer Points from this method and can repeat from step 1.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
